title: Discussing the State of AI-assisted Software Development with DORA and EarnIn
summary: Datadog, DORA and EarnIn discuss DORA metrics with AI: start AI on verification, give it internal context via MCP, and expect bottlenecks to shift to confidence and deciding what to build.
